about: 40 hand-written bad drafts (G1), made up. Each takes a demo lab report's template draft and plants one fault in one result: replaces its text (digit, direction, wording), removes it (missing) or adds an explanation for a result that isn't in the report (unknown_result). Every one must be blocked by the check named in trap, and by no other.
